goal: FG-698: Derived views and the text-rule report in the main command line

components.summary: Computed source-bound text rule reports: repeated literal passages, code spelling and path references, and attributed text for the same actual workflow; no semantic conflict verdict or stored dispositions.
responsibilities: compute text-rule facts on demand from the selected source tree and the shared inventory discovery and text-reference owners without a second parser or persistent registry
retain ordinary text and quoted passages with real path line spans normalized fingerprints and available Git provenance; group shared literal fragments without claiming semantic equivalence
distinguish exact source spelling or path existence from a licensed owner binding and preserve missing dynamic or constructed reference evidence as unknown
associate workflow text only through actual complete command or source-reference evidence and present both original passages including wording differences without inventing conflict decisions
render compact nonblocking summaries by default in human and JSON form and expose complete facts only when explicitly requested
render compact nonblocking summaries by default in human and JSON form; expose stable computed source and group selectors for complete selected original text and provenance without a registry

select originals by explicit literal substring without semantic judgments; bound related-group hints and reference summaries in selected human and JSON views while retaining full facts for explicit export

components.summary: Read-only views of the current code: source names, callers, entry routes, state writers, architecture, text references and shared flows, with explicitly supplied valid execution facts.
responsibilities: project the complete shared source inventory and discovery graph into where name tree flow architecture text and keyflow views without another parser or stored index
locate source owners, references, constants, callers and actual command handlers while keeping unresolved bindings explicit
show source-backed architecture and multiple-entry state-writing facts without treating missing rule provenance or missing test execution as proof of absence
read selected Git-reference code and text from the same source tree and attribute text/code spellings to actual files and lines
consume only supplied validated runtime or test-reach facts and distinguish them from declared bindings, stale facts and unrecorded scope
read selected Git-reference code and text from the same source tree; distinguish source spellings from document-relative exact or unique basename file candidates without granting owner bindings

derive shared cohesion facts from resolved static call edges, unique declared or module owners and actual entry facts; report candidate helper boundaries without licensing normative predicate ownership

components.summary: Dispatch actual public commands and preserve diagnostic meaning while next guidance names executable, absolute owner-scoped commands; release facts and static recovery retain their existing boundaries. Reuse the command inventory when verifying release models.
responsibilities: parse command lines and dispatch them to their owners Confirmation writes format 2 pointers and upgrades the map after all confirmed pointers are current. Model-running commands accept jobs 1-32, default to min(4, CPUs), and retain explicit --jobs 1 serial execution; the hidden verify alias keeps its existing surface. The change --verbose flag displays exact selected pytest commands.
show complete owners, closest owners, target changes, Mermaid and reviews in read; folded child names lead to full component views
annotate planned target breakage and ARCH lines in check, change and release; show fingerprint-format reminders in change

run release with the system root counted and optional whole-suite shards; reject expired debts in strict release checks and display explicit debt deadlines; reject already-applied committed targets and target deletions not staged, preserving the warning for real open targets
run bound tests and, on request, the checks an edit needs
write templates and their aliases into the active target when one exists
hint splits for large scan drafts and say when discovery finds nothing

dispatch six public static where forms to the existing derived and text-rule owners; keep selected originals on demand and next commands executable with the same absolute root and selected text revision
side_effects: writes .flowguard/map.json on scan, deps --write and confirm

components.summary: Check map/code ownership, contracts, target seams and immutable request/record bytes, retaining severity and debt provenance.
responsibilities: check anchors, files, imports, flow steps and models against the code Distinguish legacy fingerprint migration from real source staleness, using the same strict severity. Enforce target commit-seam failures only in strict mode, retaining working-mode and Gitless no-op warnings.
report one owner per entrypoint, responsibility, state and side effect

lint cycles, layers, sizes and private names, then apply only active accepted debts while keeping original record indices; report invalid deadlines as errors and expired deadlines as warnings, or errors in strict checks
explain entrypoints and state writers by model, test or reason
report file and component sizes, fan-out and shared source-bound helper cohesion candidates as non-gating advice without debt coverage; leave normative predicate and per-rule ownership unknown

remove: responsibility:report file and component sizes, duty counts and fan-out as non-gating facts without debt coverage
